author: lshaf
description: UniGeek is a single codebase that runs across many ESP32 handheld boards, turning each into a pocket security & RF multi-tool: WiFi attacks, Bluetooth scanning/spam, USB & BLE HID, NFC, IR, Sub-GHz (CC1101), NRF24, GPS wardriving, plus utilities and games.
